Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office is seeking a refresh of laptops to acquire enough units to accommodate MD529 employees who have been included in the staff as of June 1, 2023. The procurement scope includes a quantity of thirty Microsoft Copilot ready Dell Latitude 5550 laptops (SI# CC7802) and thirty Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4). Deliverables require a Dell Limited Hardware Warranty extended for 3 years on all purchased machines, with a warranty certificate or affidavit to be presented upon award. All items have a due date of June 10, 2024.

sources.quote: Office is in need of a refresh of laptops and must acquire enough laptops to accommodate MD529 employees who have been included in our staff as of June 1, 2023.
